title: Gopherfest 2015 | Go Proverbs with Rob Pike
summary: Rob Pike presents Go Proverbs at Gopherfest 2015, a set of pithy aphorisms about Go design such as 'Clear is better than clever' and 'A little copying is better than a little dependency'.
why: HN treats it as the canonical source for Go proverbs, quoted in debates about dependencies, concurrency and simplicity.
